sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Surprise is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I came up with a great idea to make the Arena even better. And I need your help. I need to find some armor plates for a guy. He's a frequent performer, so it's time to give him an upgrade to get the crowd excited. That's the thing about shows, you don't add wood in time, the fire goes out. Well, now go get me some armor plates. The crowd's gonna squeal when they see him!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Hand over 3 found in raid class 4 or higher ballistic plates to Ref

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +3,600 EXP
- Ref Rep +0.04
- 55 GP coins
  - 58 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 63 GP coins with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Killa Edition)

"Just what I needed! Not much more to go. Everyone will be thrilled when they see the results, I promise! Here's a helmet as a reward. His last owner has a better one now, ha!"
